reverse_coverage.exact_class_invariant: AI-mediated interaction must not manufacture, conceal, exploit, or materially amplify trust-bearing identity, authority, relational, emotional, contextual, vulnerability, social-proof, provenance, purpose, or urgency cues in ways that steer another actor toward a consequential action or state change without a truthful and independently assessable basis for choice.
